result.title: Verify by Doing: Co-Evolving Agent Execution and Evaluation without External Feedback
result.summary: Agent self-improvement requires feedback about task success, yet external feedback may be unavailable at test time. Agents must then infer success from observable evidence, and incomplete verification can misguide subsequent updates. We introduce Verify by Doing (VbD), a method that co-evolves Actor and Evaluator harnesses within a single task while keeping model weights fixed. The Evaluator actively inspects artifacts and environment state with tools; its findings ground an internal signal for output selection and guide updates to both execution and verification procedures. Proposed Evaluators undergo comparative review on common candidates, while Actor updates require support from their own fresh outputs. Across AutomationBench, $τ^3$ Banking, and selected GDPval tasks, VbD achieves the highest overall scores among the compared methods operating without external feedback, with gains of 3.3, 4.1, and 2.3 percentage points over the strongest baselines on the main backbone. Ablations support the contributions of active verification and Evaluator evolution, and selection from fixed candidate pools shows that improved verification can recover successful outputs without generating new ones.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Verify by Doing，在固定模型权重的前提下，让 Actor 与 Evaluator 两套 harness 在同一任务内共同演化：Evaluator 用工具主动核查产物与环境状态，形成内部验证信号用于输出选择，并据以更新执行与验证流程。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「无外部反馈下主动取证—比较评审—候选池筛选」的验证与选择机制，可能与 LVR 中答案是否真正使用 latent 内容的核验、停止决策及无标签监督问题相关，可供核查；本文无多模态 latent 状态，仅属方法线索。
